messages:
Lena: opened a tiny PR to refresh the hello-origami quickstart: auth var, minimal Docker run, and a short migration blurb for SDK v7. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1201. requesting a quick review.
Omar: looking. Node sample still uses REDWOOD_TOKEN in one spot. we should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across all languages.
Julian: spotted a broken anchor on the deploy page (deploy.md#local-run -> now #run-locally). will push an alias so old links don't 404.
Lena: thanks, fixed the env var and added a one-liner at top about the SDK v7 rename of client.call -> client.generate.
Omar: CI flagged the TypeScript fence but code has plain JS. changed to javascript and removed ts-only syntax.
help-bot: link-checker: 1 broken anchor fixed in branch.
site-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1201--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-origami  quick smoke looks fine.
Julian: added explicit docker run example `docker run -p 4000:4000 hello-origami` and EXPOSE 4000 in Dockerfile. also added HEALTHCHECK for CI stability.
Lena: pushed final tweaks. plan to merge once preview stays green, then tag a patch docs release. ETA ~25m.
Omar: quick note for support: added migration guide bullet about env var rename to avoid tickets.
Lena: great, i'll merge + update changelog after deploy finishes. :shipit:

---
Snippet (JavaScript) from PR:
```js
// minimal
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'origami-mini', prompt: 'fold a paper crane ascii' });
console.log(res.text);
```

Action items: Lena - merge + tag release; Omar - monitor support for any env-var questions; Julian - follow-up redirect PR for external links.
